items.name: General Data Protection Regulation (as applied to CRM contact/lead data)
items.scope: CRM records personal data (names, emails, phone numbers) of contacts and leads; GDPR governs its lawful basis, retention, and subjects' rights.
items.notes: Applies whenever a CRM's contacts/leads include EU/EEA individuals; consent/legitimate-interest basis for cold outreach varies by jurisdiction within the EU and must be reviewed with counsel.

items.name: CAN-SPAM Act
items.version: FTC compliance guide, current as retrieved 2026-09-26
items.scope: Governs commercial email sent from campaign/segmentation features: requires accurate headers, honest subject lines, a working opt-out, and physical address.
items.notes: Applies to commercial email sent to US recipients regardless of where the sender is based.
